note: The wire roller basket for the clam dig. Cell, pivots, dims, openings and depth computed by ClamHod at generation for all 8 headings.

cell.cpivotIs: the roller grip — pins to a CharacterIso carry anchor when carried

dims.units: m — length x width x height

keyline: render(dir, {keyline:true}) is the A/B; the shipping bake is ringless (ADR 0031)

layers.back: render(dir, {layer:"back"}) — the far half of the wire
layers.order: back -> the CatchKit2 heap clipped to opening(dir) -> front

opening.units: px from the pivot, [dx, dy] x 4 rim corners per heading (a clockwise quad)

depthPxIs: rim to floor in px at the default elevation; partial fills lower the heap surface by (1 - min(1, frac / 0.85)) x depthPx (CatchKit2.heap, _transcribed); brim crowns 2 px above the rim

materials.wire: galvanised — bucketRig's STEEL ramp, wires baked 1 px (0.012 m half-thickness) so the catch shows through
materials.bail: ash with a roller grip — bucketRig's WOOD ramp
